user.title: Sign in to Parro
user.description: Use your ParnasSys account. Your password is used only during sign-in; Home Assistant stores the resulting tokens.

account.title: Choose your account
account.description: Select the ParnasSys identity to connect. Add the integration again to connect another identity.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Parro session has expired. Sign in with the same account to reconnect.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check your email address and password.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Parro. Try again later.
error.unsupported_response: Parro returned an unsupported response. Check for an integration update.

abort.already_configured: This Parro account is already configured.
abort.session_expired: The sign-in session has expired. Start again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in with the account already connected to this integration.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: How often Home Assistant fetches the compact account summary (15–240 minutes). Message content is fetched only when you call a read action.

account_not_loaded.message: Select a loaded Parro configuration entry.

authentication_expired.message: The Parro session has expired. Sign in again from the integration settings.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach Parro. Try again later.

get_announcements.name: Get announcements
get_announcements.description: Fetch a bounded selection of school announcements. Administrators and automations only. The response can contain private school information and may be stored in automation traces.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum returned items (1–50); this is not a complete export.

get_chatrooms.name: Get conversations
get_chatrooms.description: Fetch a bounded selection of conversations, without their messages. Administrators and automations only. The response can contain private school information and may be stored in automation traces.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum returned items (1–50); this is not a complete export.

get_messages.name: Get messages
get_messages.description: Fetch a bounded selection of messages from one conversation. Administrators and automations only. The response can contain private school information and may be stored in automation traces.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum returned items (1–50); this is not a complete export.

chatroom_id.name: Conversation ID
chatroom_id.description: Use the id returned by get_chatrooms.

get_calendar_urls.name: Get calendar URLs
get_calendar_urls.description: Fetch a bounded selection of private calendar subscription URLs. Administrators and automations only. The response can contain private school information and may be stored in automation traces.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum returned items (1–50); this is not a complete export.
